page: Microsoft Azure FX4mds is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the FXMDVS family. It is powered by dedicated Intel processors and virtualized via Microsoft Hyper-V. The configuration features 4 dedicated vCPUs paired with 84.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 21.0 GB per vCPU.

This server includes 172 GB of local SSD storage and is premium storage capable, allowing for high-performance disk configurations. It does not feature any integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The hardware profile is designed specifically for memory-intensive workloads that require substantial RAM relative to compute resources.

Given the high memory density of 21.0 GB per core, the FX4mds is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that are memory-bound rather than compute-bound, reducing the need to provision excess vCPUs just to acquire sufficient RAM. This makes the instance suitable for memory-intensive applications, database caching layers, small to medium relational databases, and in-memory analytics.
